name: Sup - Friends & Conversations
description:
Sup is a social app for friends, shared interests, and the conversations that bring you together. Share a photo, make a plan, or post whatever is on your mind.

SHARE YOUR EVERYDAY
Post updates and photos, add a location, and give friends something to reply to. From weekend pictures to a quick question, there’s room for the little things.

A TIMELINE FOR EVERY INTEREST
Explore timelines and join conversations about the things you enjoy. Keep your joined timelines together, whether you’re into hiking, coffee, tech, or a game after work.

KEEP THE CONVERSATION GOING
Reply to posts, like your favorite moments, and follow the people you want to keep up with. Notifications help you catch replies, mentions, likes, and new followers.

MAKE IT YOURS
Add a profile photo and bio, share your interests with hashtags and links, and let your posts tell the rest of your story.

Sup is back to being social. Come share what’s on your mind.
